notes.title: Version 29.2
notes.content:
[b]Changes in version 29.2:[/b]

Fixed 4 achievements.

3 achievements were not triggering at all.  They were:
[list]
[*] Hunter Becomes the Hunter
[*] GOLD!
[*] Party's Over
[/list]
They should trigger now.

The achievement, "This Is the Turn That Doesn't End", was triggering after knocking off 4 blue monsters in a row, but now triggers after only knocking off 3 in a row, which is easier to achieve.

notes.title: Version 29 Released!
notes.content:
Along with the port of Monster Trampoline to Xbox One consoles, we've made a lot of changes in this version.

[b]Changes[/b]:

[list]
[*] 12 Steam achievements have been added
[*] You can now choose from 3 different AI difficulties: easy, normal, or hard
[*] The space and pirate levels have been completely redone.  In both levels, you move from one location to another throughout the game
[*] New monster animations
[*] A new cannonball special attack.  Use 3 star points to fire a purple monster at the arena from the side
[*] New music for the space level
[*] Better mixing of the music in all levels
[*] Better camerawork
[*] Improved performance
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update!  
If you have any comments or suggestions, let us know at contact@xenofusion.com

notes.title: New Level Added!
notes.content:
Some major changes have been added to Monster Trampoline just in time for Christmas with version 28!

[b]Added the Pirate Cove level:[/b]
[list]
[*] A pirate ship in a foggy, moonlit cove that shifts before a player makes a move
[*] An undersea environment with treasure and schools of fish
[*] Pirate costumes for the monsters
[/list]

[b]The Space Level has been enhanced:[/b]
[list]
[*] Platform has been redone and now has rocket boosters
[*] Asteroids now rain down on the earth as a colony ship tries to escape
[*] New music
[/list]

[b]The Oasis level has been enhanced:[/b]
[list]
[*] A sailboat, starfish, more vegetation and tropical fish have been added
[/list]

[b]Overall Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] A gameplay tutorial has been added
[*] UI text has been made sharper and clearer and other UI elements have been made clearer
[*] New sound effects have been added
[*] Camera has been improved to capture the action better
[*] Added falling monsters and level images to the opening menu    
[*] The levels have a Christmas theme that shows only in December
[*] Power bar is much more important now and has a large effect on gameplay
[*] Physics have been reworked
[/list]

notes.title: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
We’ve added a new game mode called [b]Oni mode[/b].  In this mode, all players fight for control of the platform at the same time.  Try to change the colours of as many of the monsters as you can before they fall off the platform.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34170660/4e56700d5c1b47b2f874e10f919b84ab71302253.png[/img]

Although up to two players can share the keyboard, a separate controller is recommended for each player while playing in this mode.
